study: V3 reanalysis of previously inspected EC1:5 outcomes
folds: Reuse exact V1 inner/outer membership for all ten outer splits
optical: Native Sentinel-2 valid within 30 prior days; Landsat C2 T1 valid within 45 prior days, no same day, QA excludes water and cloud
terrain: Static 2021 Copernicus GLO-30 surface elevations and 5x5-cell relief, relative elevation and central slope
missing_sources: Run available verified sources. An entirely inaccessible source is excluded uniformly before model fitting. Row eligibility never changes.
selection: Pooled inner-fold RMSE; eight fixed seed random parameter trials per main baseline family; four per architecture/ablation variant. Fixed learned convex OOF stack of top four distinct base families; optional subgroup weights are shrunk toward global weights by n/(n+40).
gate: Winning claim requires smaller primary RMSE versus relevant comparators including V1 Auto and V1 descriptive ExtraTrees, plus paired intervals and practical credibility. Reuse of known outcomes rules out independent external confirmation.

bootstrap.interval: paired percentile 95% conditional on fitted predictions
